scope: Local deterministic hosted-storage failure tests and fixes; existing TXT UI unchanged
reproduced_defects: Conditional binary modified:false incorrectly accepted when matching bytes pre-existed
Provider Error with domain-conflict text after committed message caused destructive compensation
fixes: Require modified === true for new binary writes
Use MessageConflictError identity for compensation and HTTP 409; arbitrary provider text is not a domain conflict

sdk_contract.observed: Conditional writes may resolve with modified:false and no modification ETag
